note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SWE 11; A06b SWE 11; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Act 2026:447 raised the requirement: section 11 of the Citizenship Act, as the Riksdag publishes it today, asks eight years' residence and a permanent residence permit (two years for Nordic citizens and shorter periods for some others under section 11 a, not modelled); nothing on renunciation or loss changed.

sources.title: Sveriges riksdag, Lag (2001:82) om svenskt medborgarskap (consolidated), 11 §
sources.said: 11 § En utlänning som har fyllt arton år kan efter ansökan beviljas svenskt medborgarskap (naturaliseras) om han eller hon 1. har styrkt sin identitet, 2. har permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige, 3. har hemvist här i landet sedan åtta år, om inte annat följer av 11 a §, ... Lag (2026:447) .
